items.title: Bill Phillips Interview, 1961-05-24
items.q: Harry and I, these brothers, the old days, I love, we bought some music.

ctx.x: Always did have a large house. Just me and my wife, all my kids is gone. Plenty of company on, plenty of room. I got a whole trunk of music out there. We bought more music and then the two bands sit on there. Harry and I, these brothers, the old days, I love, we bought some music. Just buy music. Everything late come out, he'd come with a stack. Leo, he'd come with a stack. I'd get down and sometimes he'd have three, four copies of the same number.
We used to join these different music clubs, you see. Yeah. And every number come out. Sometimes three music clubs will send you the same number, you know what I mean? As they come out to me.
